# ARB CKMA12 On-Board Air Install

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Install an ARB CKMA12 On-Board Air system by removing components and securing a custom-mounted compressor. [t272]

## Tools

- 10mm socket or wrench [t272]
- 4mm Allen key [t272]
- [Partial] Stainless steel pan-head machine screws (custom) [t272]
- [Partial] M5x.8 bolts with heat-shrunk tubing pins [t272]

## Parts

- ARB CKMA12 Compressor [t272]
- Inflation Kit 171302 [t272]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Drill holes in the mounting plate before installing it. [t272]
- Flip the blue cylinder bracket 180 degrees to make 4mm Allen screws easier to access. [t272]
